# Kamatham Seshadri Educational and Social Welfare Trust

> Public charitable trust in Wanaparthy, Telangana, established in memory of Kamatham Seshadri.

- Legal name: Kamatham Seshadri Educational and Social Welfare Trust

- 12A, 80G and FCRA status are not claimed

## Purpose

The trust was created to make education more reachable, build practical capability, and stand with families facing difficult costs. Benefits are open to all irrespective of caste, creed or religion. Trust funds are used for its objects; no profit, interest or dividend is paid to trustees.

Programmes will open only after funding, eligibility and operating process are ready. The public website does not accept donations or applications.

## Trustees

## Contact

Write to info@ksest.org.in. Do not send Aadhaar, bank details or confidential medical information by email.
